_meta.note: Legendary equipment icons tied to the §14 Legendary special-slot catalog. Each entry's `special` is the affix it represents; the same base sprite is reused by quality tier (a Legendary rolls one special on top of its 4-stat lean).

emberBrand.name: Ember Brand
emberBrand.note: On-hit chance to apply Burning. Bound fire Element.

lifedrinker.name: Lifedrinker
lifedrinker.note: Heals for a % of damage dealt. Void-tinged blade.

executioner.name: The Executioner
executioner.note: Bonus/true damage to enemies below 25% HP. Reaver headsman's axe.

riftedge.name: Riftedge
riftedge.note: Empowered in darkness / near a Void rift, with self-curse risk. Court of the Hollow / Cult gear.

dawnbreaker.name: Dawnbreaker
dawnbreaker.note: Bonus damage vs. void-corrupted/undead; minor self-heal on cleanse. The Light's blessing; Realm clergy.

stormcleave.name: Stormcleave
stormcleave.note: Melee hits also strike adjacent enemies. Storm Element.

farWhisper.name: The Far Whisper
farWhisper.note: +crit / bonus damage vs. unaware foes. Elf/ranger.

bramblecoat.name: Bramblecoat
bramblecoat.note: Reflects a % of melee damage taken.

wardenplate.name: Wardenplate
wardenplate.note: Chance to fully negate a hit / gain Shield. The Warden.

beaconCrown.name: Beacon Crown
beaconCrown.note: +light radius even with no torch — counters the darkness mechanic. Ties to Light's Beacon.

revenantMail.name: Revenant Mail
revenantMail.note: Survive one lethal blow per run at 1 HP. Ties to death/revival.

descentPendant.name: Descent Pendant
descentPendant.note: Grows stronger each floor you descend.

berserkersCharm.name: Berserker's Charm
berserkersCharm.note: Damage rises as your HP falls. Reaver rage.
